description: This source file provides functions for manipulating NVRAM variables, including reading, writing, rehashing, and managing the NVRAM memory map. It also includes utility functions for finding the NVRAM device, copying data to/from staging files, and handling memory maps. The file defines internal helper functions for hashing, allocating, freeing, and rehashing data structures, and offers public API functions for NVRAM handle management and variable operations.

methods.name: uint32_t hash(const char * s)
methods.description: Computes a hash value for a string, used for NVRAM variable name hashing.

methods.name: void _nvram_free(nvram_handle_t * h)
methods.description: Frees all memory associated with an NVRAM handle, including hash tables and dead entries.

methods.name: nvram_tuple_t * _nvram_realloc(nvram_handle_t * h,nvram_tuple_t * t,const char * name,const char * value)
methods.description: Allocates or reallocates an NVRAM tuple with or without a new name and value.

methods.name: int _nvram_rehash(nvram_handle_t * h)
methods.description: Reinitializes the hash table within an NVRAM handle, parsing the raw NVRAM data.

methods.name: nvram_header_t * nvram_header(nvram_handle_t * h)
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the NVRAM header within the mapped memory region.

methods.name: char * nvram_get(nvram_handle_t * h,const char * name)
methods.description: Retrieves the value associated with an NVRAM variable name.

methods.name: int nvram_set(nvram_handle_t * h,const char * name,const char * value)
methods.description: Sets or updates the value of an NVRAM variable, allocating memory as needed.

methods.name: int nvram_unset(nvram_handle_t * h,const char * name)
methods.description: Removes an NVRAM variable from the handle's hash table.

methods.name: nvram_tuple_t * nvram_getall(nvram_handle_t * h)
methods.description: Returns a linked list of all NVRAM variables and their values.

methods.name: int nvram_commit(nvram_handle_t * h)
methods.description: Regenerates and writes the NVRAM data back to the mapped memory/mtd device, including checksum calculation.

methods.name: nvram_handle_t * nvram_open(const char * file,int rdonly)
methods.description: Opens and memory-maps the NVRAM device or file, returning a handle for operations.

methods.name: int nvram_close(nvram_handle_t * h)
methods.description: Frees all resources associated with an NVRAM handle and unmaps memory.

methods.name: char * nvram_find_mtd(void)
methods.description: Detects the MTD device node for NVRAM by parsing /proc/mtd.

methods.name: char * nvram_find_staging(void)
methods.description: Checks for existence of the staging file used for NVRAM backup or staging.

methods.name: int nvram_to_staging(void)
methods.description: Copies the current NVRAM contents to the staging file.

methods.name: int staging_to_nvram(void)
methods.description: Copies data from the staging file back into the NVRAM device.

ctags.name: _nvram_realloc
ctags.signature: (nvram_handle_t * h,nvram_tuple_t * t,const char * name,const char * value)
